name: export
summary: Implemented the single settings JSON export format and connected it to the existing Export/Import dialog.
completed_work: Added SettingsExport, SettingsExportDocumentType, and SettingsExportReviewItem contracts.
Implemented exportSettings() to read document types, type-specific review items, common review items, and draftreviewr:language.
Exported document type review items nested under their owning document type.
Implemented exportSettingsJson() and getSettingsExportFileName() with draftreviewr-settings-{YYYY-MM-DD}.json naming.
Updated components/export-import-dialog.tsx so the settings export button uses the new serializer.
Preserved existing full backup export behavior and did not include API keys, documents, or review results in settings export.
decisions: Settings export version is exactly "1" per Phase 4 contract.
DocumentType.description null values are exported as an empty string to match the export contract.
The legacy exportImportStorage full backup path remains unchanged for personal backup use.
Import buttons still use the legacy import path until Step 5 upgrades import handling.

verification.notes: Export/Import dialog opened from admin page, showed the single JSON export copy, and exposed the settings export button.

known_issues: The Step 4 export format is not yet accepted by the settings import path; Step 5 is responsible for import support.
Full backup export remains in the older backup shape and intentionally still includes private/local data.
next_actions: Add parser/validator support for the version 1 single settings JSON format.
Wire replacement and merge imports through settings-serializer while preserving full backup restore behavior.
resume_hint: Resume with phases/4-standards-seed/step5.md. The settings export contract is implemented in lib/storage/settings-serializer.ts and should be reused for import shape definitions.
